comments.body:
@g4s8 don't toy mind if I change repository yaml configuration structure a little? Embedded sequences for user's permissions do have a lot of sense in our case, so I'd suggest to use mapping and properly escape asterisk:
```
permissions:
  # admin can do everything
  # john can deploy and delete
  # jane can only deploy
  # any user can download
  admin:
    - \*
  john:
    - deploy
    - delete
  jane:
    - deploy
  \*:
    - download
```
